column1: # Agency lines -> trails layer value (5 road, 15 track, 25 foot trail), burned with the OSM lines when AGENCY_LINES=1.
# `code` is the attribute value before " - " (USFS coded values such as "2 - HIGH CLEARANCE VEHICLES"), upper case; empty = no value.
# Lines whose code is not listed are not burned. Project decision (2026-10-29), proposed for review: changes routes against an OSM-only build.
